events.title: Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Hello!Steam Next Fest is here!Just a reminder that GRINDWORM is participating, so you can try the free demo on Steam now!Feedback & Bug ReportsPlease share your feedback, bug reports, technical issues and suggestions on the Steam Community Hub or Discord. All feedback is greatly appreciated!Have a nice day!Pavel

events.title: GRINDWORM Demo Walktrough
events.summary: Hey!In honor of Steam Next Fest, watch me play GRINDWORM.Pavel

events.title: GRINDWORM 0.8.9 Patch Note
events.summary: Bug Fixes:The engine sound wasn't playing.Changes:Refined dialogs to make it clearer what to do.

events.title: GRINDWORM 0.8.8 Patch Note
events.summary: Changes:Added an Invert Y-Axis option.Added a Controller Vibration Intensity option.Thanks once again to everyone who has played the demo and shared their feedback with me!Your feedback means a lot to me and helps me improve the game. I'm continuing to work on making the experience better, so please keep playing and let me know what you think!If you encounter any bugs, have suggestions or simply want to share your thoughts about the game, don't hesitate to leave your feedback on the Steam Commun

events.title: GRINDWORM is taking part in The MIX Fall Online Showcase
events.summary: Hey there!I'm excited to share that GRINDWORM has been officially selected to participate in The MIX Fall Online Showcase on October 16!Featuring upcoming games from developers and publishers around the world, the showcase will include new game reveals, trailers, announcements, developer updates, and more!Stay tuned! 👀Pavel

events.title: GRINDWORM 0.8.7 Patch Note
events.summary: Changes:Added gamepad vibration.Added a gamepad vibration mode selector under Options -> Controls.Added low oxygen and engine overheating notifications.The machine's door is now visibly damaged after the mine collapse, making it clearer that it cannot be opened. When inspected, the protagonist will remark that it is damaged and cannot be opened.Significantly reduced the likelihood of getting stuck in tight spaces.Thanks a lot to everyone who has played the demo and shared their feedback with me!

events.title: Demo Out Now!
events.summary: Hello everyone!I'm happy to announce that the demo for GRINDWORM is now live on Steam, ahead of its participation in Steam Next Fest!Here's the trailer showing a little bit of what's in store.Watch the trailer on YouTubeThe demo is localized into 13 languages. Enjoy!And remember: DON'T. STOP. DIGGING.Feedback & Bug ReportsPlease share your feedback, bug reports, technical issues and suggestions on the Steam Community Hub or Discord. All feedback is greatly appreciated!Pavel

events.title: GRINDWORM just got a fresh new look!
events.summary: Hello miners!I'm thrilled to announce that GRINDWORM now has striking new key art and a brand-new logo by Bokkimi! I hope you like them as much as I do. Let me know what you think in the comments!Stay tuned for more exciting news soon!Have a great day,Pavel

events.title: GRINDWORM is heading to Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Good news, everyone!It's official! GRINDWORM is heading to Steam Next Fest, starting October 19th! I hope you're as excited as I am, because I absolutely can't wait!Wishlist GRINDWORM to stay up to date and make sure you don't miss anything!Have a nice day!Pavel

events.title: I'm happy to announce GRINDWORM is taking part in Endix Showcase May 23-24th
events.summary: I'm excited to be a part of the Endix Showcase!What is the Endix Showcase?Endix is a free virtual/digital event built as a game in Unreal Engine, this allows you to join the Showcase on your own terms.Visit Endix on Steam to create your own avatar and jump into a digital theme world, showing tons of beloved and new games that might not have been on your radar yet.You can find GRINDWORM's booth at Theatrum Obscurum.Come support GRINDWORM and other games on May 23-24th!

events.title: Update: Localization
events.summary: Hey indie horror game lovers!I'm excited to share that GRINDWORM now has an official list of supported languages, and the Steam page has already been fully localized!Check out the updated store page and see how it looks in your language.And while you're here, adding GRINDWORM to your wishlist helps support the project and makes sure you don't miss any future updates or the release.👉 WISHLIST GRINDWORM ON STEAMHave a nice day!Pavel

events.title: A Quick Hello and Holiday Wishes
events.summary: Hi everyone!I'm Pavel, the developer of GRINDWORM.You may have noticed that things have been a little quiet around here lately. Just wanted to take a moment to explain that the silence wasn't a lack of progress. Quite the opposite. Development has been moving steadily and the game is on track. I'm looking forward to the game's release in 2026.As the year comes to a close, I'd also like to wish all of you happy holidays.All the best! See ya!
